description: Expand the original five-path fused representation with a learned projection reading its existing fusion input.
authorization: Original PAMF features only, multiple native expansion methods, fully supervised, no augmentation. This matched probe covers one epoch; formal budget is 100 epochs.

data.dataset: Oxford SatIQ Zenodo 8220494, first 1010464 chronological packets
data.representation: Only 8000-point common-word prefix, resampled to the original 256-point native view before any branch encoding. Existing 11000-point cache unchanged.
data.support_query_ref: Transient source V enrollment K1/16. Independent T (50000) separately staged; no training access.

permissions.claim_scope: Only the existing 8000-point common-word L and fixed source V. No held-out test access.

checkpoint.selection_rule: Scratch and same native parameters, source order and 5000/20000/28225 source checkpoints as native fused320. No held-out inputs.

execution.launch_owner: Single pre-fusion PAMF-SUP row and its local coordinator
execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU0, >=4096 MiB free and <=2 incumbent jobs.

metric_names: individual train CE, MSE and triplet
PAMF within-satellite CE, two view CE, and posterior KL
dimensions: 1375 source K1/K16 reference classes and 12785 matched queries
28225 updates and 903200 distinct labeled records in one complete source epoch

rows.method: PAMF-SUP with 160 expanded coordinates from native fusion input
rows.purpose: Test access to the existing fusion input before the original 160-coordinate layer at matched parameter count.
rows.seed_notes: Shared deterministic class-pair batching and validation references. No synthetic augmentation.
rows.scenario: Oxford native real received, paper-style random message split
rows.budget_ref: 28225 updates, same 903200 labeled waveform sequence as fused320.

notes: Reuse only the original native fused 160 and the existing native fusion layer's 321-dimensional input.
MLP 481-128-160 has the same 82656 parameters as the paired fused320 MLP 160-256-160.
Five branch prototypes at 0.5; expansion-specific prototype coefficient 0. Identical source pair ordering, no augmentation and no extra signal features.
